title: 61,000 Bitcoin Found in Britain… Taken from 128,000 People 👑
lesson: Every bitcoin move stays on a public record. Crime leaves a trail forever.
description:
2014-2017: Zhimin Qian ran an investment fraud in China with 128,000 victims, then fled on a fake passport to the UK. UK police seized 61,000 BTC, a UK record. She wanted to become 'monarch' of the micronation Liberland. A transfer to her helper led police to arrest her in York in 2024. She pleaded guilty and in November 2025 was sentenced to 11 years and 8 months.

Not financial advice. Entertainment and education only.
pinned: What should happen to the 61,000 bitcoin? 👇

scenes.line: 61,000 bitcoin. Found in Britain. Taken from 128,000 people in China.
2014 to 2017. Zhimin Qian runs a fake investment scheme in China.

receipt.headline: UK sentences Chinese scammer after record-breaking Bitcoin seizure

scenes.line: Police close in. She flees on a fake passport, through Southeast Asia, to the UK.
There, she lives a lavish life. And tries to buy London houses with bitcoin.
That's her mistake. In 2018, a law firm raises the alarm. Police seize the bitcoin. 61,000 coins. A UK record.
Her dream: to become the 'monarch' of a tiny micronation called Liberland.
In 2024, a fast-food worker who helped her gets a small bitcoin transfer. Police are watching. They arrest her in York.
In 2025, she pleads guilty. Her sentence: 11 years and 8 months. Her accomplice gets almost 5 years.

receipt.headline: UK court jails Chinese bitcoin fraudster for over 11 years

scenes.line: Those coins? Worth almost 5 billion dollars today.
